**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user inquired about a trophy between Ireland and Scotland in the Six Nations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There is no specific trophy awarded between Ireland and Scotland in the Six Nations Championship.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ireland and Scotland compete annually for the Centenary Quaich, which is a trophy awarded to the winner of their Six Nations match.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Centenary Quaich was first presented in 1989 to commemorate the centenary of the first-ever meeting between the two teams in 1879.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Quaich is a Scottish drinking cup traditionally used for whisky, named after the Gaelic word for cup.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Centenary Quaich is not an official Six Nations trophy but is a separate trophy contested between Ireland and Scotland during their annual Six Nations match.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Quaich is currently held by Ireland, who won their 2021 Six Nations encounter with Scotland by a score of 27-24.
